text:
Ana R.: quick heads-up — Solvexa (onboarding) spiked during model ingest this morning, hitting 6k QPS for short bursts. Customer asked for a temporary rate lift + egress allowlist to eu-west to finish dataset seeding. can we scope?
Raj P.: noted. do we have their IP ranges and expected sustained qps after ingest?
Ana R.: customer sent CIDRs and expected steady-state ~400 qps, but first 24–48h will be heavy. CIDRs: ```34.89.120.0/22, 35.201.16.0/22``` they also requested eu-west-1 routing for lower latency.
Leah M.: can do eu-west peering and add those CIDRs to proxy-allowlist. recommend a temporary rate window rather than permanent uplift. how long do we want to grant? 48h or 72h?
Tom S.: 72h is fine from account side — gives them time to finish ingest and validates retention/usage. flag renewal risk: they're trialing and trial ends next week, but high usage suggests value — schedule enablement.
Kai L.: i'll run a focused enablement call: quick best-practices on prefix caching, batching, and KV warm-up. propose 30m tomorrow. link to calendar invite once we confirm window.
Ana R.: also capturing feedback: they reported occasional token-timeouts at ~3500 tokens during long-generation runs — asked if we have model variant or KV cache tuning to avoid OOMs.
Raj P.: for long generations we should pin them to model-x-8k-quant (more stable memory footprint) or enforce max_new_tokens=1500. i'll add a canary policy to route long requests to dedicated variant.
Leah M.: infra plan: apply proxy allowlist + route policy now, create temporary rate-limit policy: 6k burst with 5000 sustained for 72h, autorevoke at T+72h. i'll open infra ticket and link here.
infra-bot: Created ticket CS-2026-078 — Infra: Add allowlist + temp rate window for Solvexa. SLA target: complete within 3 hours.
Leah M.: ticket link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-2026-078 — assigning to netops. tagging @Raj P. for routing tweaks. :rocket:
Raj P.: prepping rollout steps: 1) add CIDRs to proxy, 2) add routing policy to prefer eu-west-1 endpoints, 3) attach temp rate-limit policy to customer route, 4) monitor latency/err rates for 3h post-change. I'll post logs here.
Tom S.: noted — finance check: temporary uplift is free as part of onboarding; if sustained after trial we'll convert to Dedicated quota proposal. flag renewal rep to follow in 7 days.
Kai L.: scheduling enablement: proposing 09:30 UTC tomorrow, 30m. i'll prepare a short deck on batching and cache warmups and include sample cURL snippets.
Ana R.: customer ok with 72h and wants the autorevoke. they asked for a post-window summary of usage and a short list of optimization suggestions to present to their CTO.
Raj P.: change going out in ~20m. will drop a followup with the first 1h metrics snapshot. :eyes:
Leah M.: changes applied — proxy allowlist + eu-west routing + temp rate-limit live. monitoring.
infra-bot: CS-2026-078 status -> RESOLVED (changes deployed) by Leah M.
Raj P.: 1h snapshot: burst handled, p95 latency down ~40% from prior routing, error rate stayed under 0.3%. saving logs to /s3/cs/solvexa/ingest-2026-03-19-01h.json
Tom S.: great. i'll prep a renewal touchpoint and send invite to the CTO for follow-up review in 5 days. note for playbook: consider proactive temp-allowlist and trial burst path for future large ingests.
Kai L.: enablement invite sent to contact@solvexa.com for 09:30 UTC tomorrow. will attach brief optimization checklist after call.
Ana R.: capturing customer feedback: happy with latency improvement and appreciate the quick turnaround. will send formal thank-you and share playbook suggestions. closing loop here. :white_check_mark:
